settings.title: Frequently asked
settings.lede: Quick answers on shipping, returns, certifications, sizing, and gifting. Still stuck? Tap WhatsApp.

settings.question: Are your gemstones certified?
settings.answer: Yes. Every piece is BIS hallmarked where applicable and accompanied by a certificate of authenticity. Our gemstones are lab-tested and sourced through GJEPC-certified channels.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping in India?
settings.answer: Free standard shipping on orders above ₹2,999. Express options are available at checkout.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer 7-day returns on unworn items in original packaging. Custom and personalized pieces are non-returnable.

settings.question: How do I find my ring size?
settings.answer: Use the ring size guide on any ring product page, or message us on WhatsApp and we will walk you through it.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes — international shipping is available on request. Reach out and we will share rates and timelines.

settings.question: Can I commission a custom piece?
settings.answer: Yes. Send us a brief over WhatsApp or email and our atelier team will respond within two business days.
